meaning:
ἀπάτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ὴ
(ἀ- neg., πατήρ)
1. fatherless.
2. without father (MM, VGT, see word), i.e., with no recorded genealogy: Heb.7:3.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest…
